title: Two drafts-cleared events in one task, before React re-renders, would call drop() twice and go back twice
evidence: From PR 1765's review (R4); theory only, and on main before PR 1765 too. useValuePage listens for DRAFTS_CLEARED_EVENT with drop (widget-src/src/lib/useValuePage.ts:108, :111); drop() sends close and calls window.history.back() when on the page's entry (:64-68). Its listener is the one bound for the open page (effect deps [open], :113), so two `hr:drafts-cleared` dispatches in one task, before a re-render rebinds it, would each run drop(), and history.back() would run twice, going one history entry further back than the page. Not seen: HealthTool.erase-event-pins.test.tsx:328 asserts one dispatch per erase (toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)). Remedy if it ever matters: drop() goes back only when the view it closes is a page.
